src/browser-confirmation-request.ts.name: Confirmation request shape
src/browser-confirmation-request.ts.description: Describes the request Paja raises before a napplet signs, publishes or uploads, so the prompt can show what is at stake.

src/browser-grant-retirement.ts.name: Close tabs on revoke
src/browser-grant-retirement.ts.description: Picks which open tabs lost a grant when the developer revokes one, and names a napplet by its tab title.

src/browser-host-signer.ts.name: Confirmations and signer controls
src/browser-host-signer.ts.description: Runs the queue of on-screen confirmations (fails closed) and the signer picker, including detecting a NIP-07 browser signer.

src/browser-host-storage.ts.name: Saved tabs and catalog
src/browser-host-storage.ts.description: Saves and reloads open napplet tabs, installed-napplet pointers and intent handler choices in host storage, tolerating storage failures.

src/browser-nip46-client.ts.name: Remote signer client
src/browser-nip46-client.ts.description: Connects to a NIP-46 remote signer from a bunker or nostrconnect link and forwards signing requests over relays.

src/browser-operation-scope.ts.name: Per-window authority
src/browser-operation-scope.ts.description: Binds each service call to the napplet window that sent it, so signing, publishing and CVM traffic carry the right source.

src/browser-permission-adapter.ts.name: Firewall prompt adapter
src/browser-permission-adapter.ts.description: Connects Kehto's firewall to Paja: applies default rules, shows prompts for 'ask', saves grants, and reports revocations.

src/browser-permission-rules.ts.name: Default firewall rules
src/browser-permission-rules.ts.description: Ships default rules that allow every offered interface except opening external links, which always asks; saved in host storage.

src/browser-signer-consent.ts.name: Remembered signing consent
src/browser-signer-consent.ts.description: Remembers which event kinds, or all kinds, a napplet may sign or publish without asking, tied to the exact signer, napplet version and target; falls back to memory when storage is unavailable.

src/browser-signers.ts.name: Signer choice
src/browser-signers.ts.description: Switches between the built-in development key, a NIP-07 browser extension and a NIP-46 remote signer, and reports connection state.
